en: A colorized panoramic view of a valley town surrounded by high, barren mountains. In the foreground are orchards or cultivated fields and scattered houses with red-tiled roofs. A long multi-arched aqueduct or viaduct curves through the greenery. Beyond it stretches a compact town with low buildings, some with bright facades, set at the base of the mountains. A rail line runs along the lower edge of the scene. The style is that of an early 20th‑century printed postcard. No visible caption or text appears on the image side.
